facts.text: Maria volunteered at a shelter's front desk last Friday.

evidence.quote: Last Friday, I spent some time at the shelter volunteering at the front desk.

facts.text: Maria observed smiles on people's faces when they received food or a bed at the shelter.

evidence.quote: Seeing the smiles on their faces when they got food or a bed really made me feel good.

facts.text: Maria expressed that she and John have the power to make a difference in people's lives.

evidence.quote: We have the power to make a difference in people's lives.
